title: Session chip, "Since last session" and Pin to Desk
summary: DMs get a session chip in the header, a summary of what happened since the last session, pinned screens on the Desk and quick hit-point buttons during fights.
items: The header shows "Session 12 · day 42"; tap it for End & start next, Session Time and what happened since the last session.
The Desk lists loot awarded, money in and out, requests waiting and characters away since the last session ended.
Pin to Desk at the top of a feature screen adds it to your shortcuts, which then show as a Pinned row on the Desk.
During an encounter, the Desk's party cards have − and + to adjust hit points by one.
On phones, Help and the session chip sit at the top of Settings & Management on every screen.
